notes.title: 2025/08/04 Update & Optimization
notes.notes:
2025/08/04 Update & Optimization
[olist]
Mech Mode parameter tuning
• Shell-resupply activation time reduced to 10 s.
• When not taking damage, HP auto-regenerates 2/200 per second.
• New “Easy Difficulty” lets you call in AI mech teammates for support.

Roach control update
• Default camera now follows terrain and mouse movement.
• Press V to toggle back to the original control scheme.
• Mouse-wheel adjusts camera zoom.

Roach Mode difficulty lowered
• Time needed to activate a nest halved.
• Energy required to charge skills halved.
• Rapid HP regeneration when out of danger.

Tutorial page guidance refined.
[/olist]

notes.title: 2025/07/22 Update
notes.notes:
[olist]
Removed energy cost for attacking and sprinting.

Reduced energy regen to 10 per second (out of 100 max).

Lowered mech HP to 200.

Ammo packs now respawn every 60 s when none are available.

Extended mech ability duration to 40 s.

Added cockroach camera-rotation toggle (V to switch).

Faster transition from walk to sprint.


…More improvements on the way!
[/olist]
